name: Ginkgo biloba extract
description: Ginkgo biloba extract (CAS 90045-36-6 ), commonly referred to as GBE, is a standardized botanical extract derived from the leaves of the Ginkgo biloba tree. It is used across nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, and cosmetic manufacturing as an antioxidant active and functional ingredient. Buyers typically source it in standardized ratios, most commonly 10:1 aqueous extract, to meet consistent formulation requirements. In dietary supplement manufacturing, GBE is incorporated into capsules, tablets, and softgels targeting cognitive and circulatory health positioning. Cosmetic formulators use it in anti-aging serums, creams, and scalp treatments where antioxidant activity supports product claims around skin protection and vitality. Functional food and beverage producers incorporate it into fortified drinks and energy blends. These wellness shots utilize botanical actives as a key label differentiator for modern consumers. In pharmaceutical and OTC product development, standardized GBE serves as an active botanical ingredient in formulations requiring documented extract ratios. The material is produced to meet defined marker compound levels for consistent efficacy. Ginkgo biloba extract is supplied as a fine powder, typically brown to tan in color, in both conventional and organic-certified grades for global distribution.
